notes.title: 0.003a update
notes.notes:
-Huge performance boost, with FPS raised by 5-20 on average.
-New lighting and shade effect.
-New terrain material.
-3D clouds added, as well as new dynamic weather.
-Brand new character animation with movement like ducking and continuous shooting.
-New randomly-generated maps.
-Emojis after AIs are killed.
-New game mechanism: Manual saving is abolished and game will automatically save every day. 
-The space capsule no longer has the function of standing-by.
-AIs will not attack players sponstaneously during the day, but will attack and spawn at night.
-There will be an island in the sky, which players can land on by constructing aerial vehicles.

After this update we will immediately begin working on multiplayer support and thorough renovation of the game.
We will soon make beta tests of the game available to every player.
The multiplayer support is estimated to complete in 2-3 months.
The beta tests may include various bugs and lack of functions, as it is used to test new function and gaming experience.
More sophisticated version will be available after 2-3 months.

notes.title: weekend update
notes.notes:
[New content and adjustment]
- Blocks from Steam Workshop now can be unlocked in the story mode.
- Remove the powerful effect of sideswiping bullets (AIs can no longer blow vehicles away )
- The explosion of artillery bombs now will generate strong impact, making it easier to eliminate AIs.
- Ornaments, such as candles and lamps,  are added in the Pit.
- Improve the UI of refinery.
- Some new art resource is added.

[Bugs fixed]
- Fix the bug: The cutscene is repeated after the player gets out of the pit.
- Fix the bug: The UI of construction is still visible when the player is equipping or photographing amid construction.

notes.title: new update is here, 0.0002c
notes.notes:
[h1]New content and adjustment[/h1]

[list]
[*]Elite enemies are added.
[*]Mining may infuriate AIs
[*]Make some change to parts of the map, the amount of ore deposit, and the mechanism by which enemies spawn.
[*]Add three new NPCs to the "Island" level, which respectively explain "fight", "construction", and "mining" (under construction yet).
[*]Now, there are stone ore deposit and refinery in the pit, which will lead to more choices for players to get out of the pit, while exposes players to mining in a earlier time .
[*]Adjustment to the durability of some building blocks. The steel block will be more durable to attack, which make it possible for players to construct defensive building.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixed[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fix the bug: The extenable(telescopic) platform is hard to control in story mode.
[*]Fix the bug: The right button of mouse does not work in the cockpit
[*]Fix the bug: After the data connected object is removed, the UI still indicates data connection.
[*]Fix the bug: After loading a save, the removed object appears abnormally due to previous data connection.
[*]Fix the bug with refining amount single time and the rate of refining.
[*]Fix the bug: The setting of language does not work after saving the setting.
[*]Fix the bug: The material of spotlight reports anomaly.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0002b update is here
notes.notes:
[New Content]
-A new NPC is added to the "Island" Chapter. Now you can directly skip the "Island" Chapter to enter the Desert.
-New generating mechanism for scannable items. There will be more scannable items in the world.

[Adjustment]
-The output power of the jet engine is enhanced to 5 times.
-Add more AIs.
-More items and more stone ore.
-The (color) tone of the map is adjusted.
-Adjustment of mines: It will be easier to shoot and destroy mines. Mines will no longer explode under photo mode.
-Mines can be marked through map scan. (Z)

[Bugs fixed]
-Fix the bug: The 3D printer floats in the air after loading a save.
-Fix the bug: Submission of blueprints in the Steam Workshop sometimes fails.
-Fix the bug: The control room mission will restart after loading a save.
-Fix the bug: Error with the position when the character leave the cockpit during a drive.
-Fix the bug: The durability bar cannot be seen after players quit the photo mode.
-Fix the bug with saving.
-Fix the bug: Possibility that the character cannot move if the load is reduced after overloading situation.

notes.title: a big update is alive.
notes.notes:
- Mines will appear in the game environment. Be careful!
- The vibration of camera and the depth of field can now be manually switched on and off. (Two untranslated item in the "camera" setting)
- Update on Island mission, less interaction limitation, change of dialogue with the pirate.
- Optimization of various sound effect
- The night in the desert will be more dangerous.
- Skill points will not initialize after death, but EXP will reduce.
- The EXP system is optimized.
- The effect of lacking electricity will appear when the value is below 200.
- The effect of damage will appear when the value is below 200.
- TEMPORARY FUNCTION: The space capsule now has the function of standby, which allows players to skip the time to 6am.
- Fix some rocks in the desert.
- Add some blueprints and garbage in certain position of the desert.
- New "Freshmen Instruction" and fix of island items setting is under work.
- Update the material required for rocket mission.Control room and 3D printer now can save.
- Fix bugs with missions in the desert.
- Fix the bug where the space capsule near the pit cannot be dismantled and where infinite EXP is provided.

and we will make another update later today to fix save bugs.
